main_text.p: Conscia, consentiente uxore sua, Act.5.2. Plur.masc.

[Hebrew] Non sentientes, ignorantes, ad Hebr. 13.2. Ithpeh. [Hebrew]. Ithpahel [Hebrew] Tumultuari, tumultuose concurrere, convenire: Cōmovere, concuti, contremiscere. Aphel [Hebrew] Idem, Psalm.72.16. Ruth.1.19. Dan.6.6. Item Convenire facere, congregare, Josu.7.3. Item Syr. Sentire, animadvertere, intelligere, cognoscere, Mar.5.29. Act.13.27. 1.Joh.2.3.
[Hebrew] Ch. Fremitus, strepitus, tumultuatio, tumultus, Jesa.22.5.
[Hebrew] Syr. Idem. Hinc [Hebrew] Filii tonitruum, Graec. βοανηργὲς, quomodo Christus vocavit filios Zebedaei, Marc.3.17.
[Hebrew] Ch. Coetus, turba. [Hebrew] Quippe vertens me ad quaerendum coetum vel societatem, Proverb.7.15.
[Hebrew] Chal. Fremitus, strepitus, tumultus, tumultuatio. Plurale foemin. [Hebrew], unde cū Aff. [Hebrew] Ezech.22.5. & [Hebrew], Psal.73.19. & masc. [Hebrew], Psal.55.12.
[Hebrew] Ch. Sensatio, sensus, Job.20.1. Elias legit [Hebrew] Festinatio. Respondet enim Hebraeo [Hebrew].
[Hebrew] Et expediti sunt sesus eorum, Hebr.5.14.
[Hebrew] Ch. Dominari, dominium, dominatum exercere: Deinde Ch. & Syr. Castigare, erudire, admonere, corripere: Item Arare proprie: & metaphorice Syr. Arare, sulcare aequor, mare, Navigare, re-

page.notes: Hebrew, Aramaic/Syriac and Greek words are printed in their scripts; the Hebrew forms are given as [Hebrew] placeholders where the exact pointed letters could not be reliably reproduced. Line ends "re,re-" at the foot are the catchword-like continuation, not a separate paragraph; the catchword "re," is possibly "re-".
